info.title: hr:exchange
info.description: Users authenticate themselves to the DATEV data center via OAuth. After a successful authentication and authorization, the user can exchange payroll relevant data with both two payroll systems, LODAS or Lohn und Gehalt. Data can be retrieved as well as written. Possible values for employee and client data are described in this document under custom x-allowed-values-* tags. The variations are: -enum (specific values allowed), -lower/upper-bound (minimum and maximum values), -regex (Regex-Expression to test for correct values) and -max-length (defining the maximum length of a string). Data transfer is processed in an asynchronous manner, because the on-premise target system might be temporararily offline. Therefore, a data transfer request just creates a job in a queue and returns its job-uuid immediately. The client application uses the job-uuid in subsequent requests to monitor its progress and to retrieve the final result. For read transfers, specify the resource to be read within the body of a POST request to /v1/clients/{client-id}/jobs For write transfers, several endpoints are provided, depending on the resource that shall be created, updated or deleted. Most prominent will be POST or PUT to /v1/clients/{client-id}/employees To monitor job progress, use a GET request on /v1/clients/{client-id}/jobs/{job-uuid} To finally fetch the result, use GET on /v1/clients/{client-id}/jobs/{job-uuid}/result As an alternative to progress polling, the client application may provide an endpoint to be notified by hr-exchange upon job completion. See /v1/clients/{client-id}/resthooks
info.x-datev-shortdescription: With the REST API hr-exchange (Lohnaustauschdatenservice), payroll relevant data can be exchanged from the DATEV payroll systems to a third party software and vice versa.
